en_excerpt: A budget-friendly cupcake batter that bakes up light and moist, plus a gourmet brigadeiro topping from Chef Sonia Campos.
en_meta_description: A budget-friendly cupcake recipe from Chef Sonia Campos, with a gourmet brigadeiro topping or filling for every cake.
en_content:
Chef Sonia Campos @grannymadeireland

Thinking about the cost of ingredients, I developed this perfect batter! Budget-friendly, it comes out light, moist and super simple to make.

It can be made in a blender, or even mixed by hand with a whisk.

The kids will love it!!!

WRITE DOWN THE RECIPE:

1 large egg (60g) 250g whole milk

1 cup 115g soya or sunflower oil

Half a cup 240g plain flour

2 cups 180g sugar

1 cup 30g cocoa powder 50%

2 tablespoons 15g baking powder

1 tablespoon of cornflour

Tip: TO MAKE THE WHITE BATTER, JUST LEAVE OUT THE COCOA

POWDER AND ADD 15ML OF VANILLA ESSENCE OR

SCRAPINGS FROM A VANILLA POD.

Blend everything in the blender for 5 min.

Pour into a bowl and gradually add the sifted plain flour, mix well and, last of all,

add the baking powder. Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees.

GOURMET BRIGADEIRO TOPPING:

1 tin of

condensed milk,

200g of cream,

20g of cocoa powder,

100g of chocolate blend, milk or dark

15g of unsalted butter (this gives the topping extra shine).

Bring to the heat, stirring slowly, until it reaches the thick ribbon stage. Leave it to cool and cover your

cupcakes.

Another option: instead of topping them, you can fill your cupcakes

with this brigadeiro.
